actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereboar makes two attacks, using

actions.name: Javelin or Tusk in any combination
actions.description: It can replace one attack with a Gore attack.

actions.name: Gore (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll:
+5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Wereboar under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this wereboar's curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Javelin (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tusk (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll:
+5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the wereboar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.description: The wereboar shape-shifts into a Medium

bonus_actions.name: boar-humanoid hybrid or a Small boar, or it returns to its true humanoid form
bonus_actions.description: Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
